products.name: Broad Spectrum Pesticide
products.tagline: Effective control for a pest-free field
products.shortDescription: Ultra-potent combined lepidopteran and sucking pest protector with swift paralytic knockdown.
products.fullDescription: Broad Spectrum Pesticide is formulated specifically for intensive agricultural zones. Combining fast contact kill with translaminar protection, it controls bollworms, spodoptera caterpillars, jassids, and thrips in cotton, rice, and vegetable crops.
products.dosage: 300 - 400 ml per acre in 100-120 Liters of clean water
products.applicationMethod: Foliar spray with hollow cone nozzle when pest threshold reaches economic level.
precautions: Wear protective gloves and mask during preparation
Keep 7 days safety interval before harvest
Avoid application during extreme midday heat

products.name: NPK 20-20-20 Soluble
products.shortDescription: Pure 100% water-soluble crystalline fertilizer fortified with essential chelated trace elements.
products.fullDescription: Provides balanced Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium in equal 1:1:1 ratios alongside EDTA Zinc and Boron. Rapidly absorbed through leaf stomata and root hairs, it rejuvenates stunted crops and ensures robust yield tonnage.
products.activeIngredient: Total N: 20%, Available P2O5: 20%, Soluble K2O: 20% + Trace Elements
products.dosage: 2 - 3 kg per acre for foliar spray, or 5-10 kg per acre in flood/drip fertigation
products.applicationMethod: Foliar spray in 100-120L water or direct tank dissolution for drip fertigation.
precautions: Store in a dry cool store room
Keep airtight to prevent caking in high humidity

products.name: Herbicide Plus
products.shortDescription: High-selectivity post-emergence herbicide for eradicating obstinate weeds and sedges.
products.fullDescription: Formulated to terminate wide-spectrum grass and broad-leaf weeds without causing leaf yellowing or crop stunting. Rapidly translocates to the root crown of weeds within 6 hours of application.
products.dosage: 100 gm per acre in 100-120 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Spray 15-22 days after transplanting in moist standing field moisture.
precautions: Do not spray during high winds
Use dedicated herbicide spray tank or clean thoroughly

products.name: Fungicide Gold
products.shortDescription: Broad-spectrum systemic strobilurin & triazole fungicide delivering superior greening effect.
products.fullDescription: Fungicide Gold combines preventative spore barrier action with deep translaminar cure. Defends crops from rusts, powdery mildew, blast, and blight while extending the green leaf duration (Stay-Green effect) for maximum starch production.
products.dosage: 200 ml per acre in 100-120 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Preventive foliar spray at first appearance of disease weather or early symptoms.
precautions: Shake well before measuring
Rotate chemistry to prevent fungal strain tolerance

products.name: Belt Expert Insecticide
products.shortDescription: Innovative dual action formulation providing unmatched lepidopteran control and sucking pest knockdown.
products.fullDescription: Belt Expert combines Flubendiamide and Thiacloprid. It causes instantaneous feeding cessation in caterpillars while disrupting pest nervous transmission, delivering long-lasting crop safety.
products.dosage: 150 ml per acre in 100 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Foliar application during evening time with hollow cone nozzle.
precautions: Wear protective spectacles and apron
Keep away from domestic animals and food

products.name: Sarsabz CAN (Gohar)
products.shortDescription: Premium granulated fertilizer combining nitrate nitrogen with calcium for rapid vegetative uptake.
products.fullDescription: Sarsabz CAN contains 26% total Nitrogen (50% Nitrate Nitrogen for immediate crop consumption and 50% Ammoniacal Nitrogen for sustained feeding) alongside 10% soluble Calcium to reinforce plant cell walls.
products.dosage: 1 to 2 bags (50-100 kg) per acre during second and third irrigation
products.applicationMethod: Broadcast evenly across the field before irrigation flood.
precautions: Do not mix with superphosphate before field application
Store on pallets off wet ground

products.name: Karate 2.5 EC
products.shortDescription: World's most renowned rapid action pyrethroid against chewing and sucking insects.
products.fullDescription: Karate 2.5 EC delivers fast paralyzing action on insects upon contact and ingestion. Features high rainfastness and repellency, driving insects out of hidden floral parts.
products.dosage: 330 - 400 ml per acre in 100 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Thorough foliar coverage targeting lower leaf canopy.
precautions: Toxic to aquatic organisms - keep away from fish ponds
Do not spray against headwind

products.name: Engro DAP (Diammonium Phosphate)
products.tagline: Foundation of root strength & harvest yield
products.shortDescription: Highest grade ammoniacal phosphorus ensuring phenomenal root anchorage and early seedling vigor.
products.fullDescription: Engro DAP provides 18% Nitrogen and 46% Phosphorus in high water solubility. Applied at seedbed preparation to jumpstart root architecture and accelerate early crop establishment.
products.dosage: 1 to 1.5 bags (50-75 kg) per acre applied at sowing time
products.applicationMethod: Drill application with seed drill or uniform broadcast before final planking.
precautions: Ensure proper soil moisture at time of drilling
Store in well-ventilated dry warehouse

products.name: Super Root & Bloom PGR
products.tagline: Stronger roots, better fruit set, higher harvest
products.shortDescription: Balanced botanical gibberellic acid and brassinolide booster to prevent flower drop.
products.fullDescription: Super Root & Bloom accelerates cellular elongation and optimizes vascular sap flow during high-temperature stress periods. Significantly reduces flower shedding in cotton and chilies while promoting uniform fruit caliber.
products.dosage: 10-20 gm per acre in 100 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Foliar spray during early morning at pre-bloom and peak flowering stages.
precautions: Do not overdose recommended concentration
Ensure uniform tank dissolution

products.name: Zinc Chelate 15% (EDTA)
products.tagline: Instant cure for Khaira & zinc deficiency
products.shortDescription: 100% chelated zinc ensuring maximum absorption in alkaline Pakistani soils.
products.fullDescription: Unlike raw zinc sulphate which gets tied up with soil phosphorus, this EDTA-chelated Zinc remains fully bio-available. Restores stunted plants, cures bleached leaf symptoms in paddy rice, and stimulates vegetative enzymes.
products.dosage: 500 gm per acre in 100-120 Liters of water (Foliar)
products.applicationMethod: Foliar spray at 20-30 days after transplanting / emergence.
precautions: Can be mixed with standard insecticides and fungicides safely

products.name: Atlantis 3.6 WDG Herbicide
products.tagline: Total weed control solution in wheat
products.shortDescription: Two-in-one post-emergence weedicide controlling both narrow and broad leaf weeds in wheat.
products.fullDescription: Atlantis 3.6 WDG controls canary grass (Dumbi Sitti), wild oats, and broad-leaf weeds in wheat fields with built-in mefenpyr safener protecting the wheat plant.
products.dosage: 160 gm + 400 ml surfactant per acre in 120 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Flat fan nozzle spray 30-35 days after wheat sowing after first irrigation.
precautions: Do not use on oat or barley crops
Ensure soil has proper moisture during application

products.name: Nativo 75 WG Fungicide
products.tagline: Premier protection against fungal blast & blight
products.shortDescription: Combined systemic fungicide delivering disease immunity and yield enhancement.
products.fullDescription: Nativo combines Tebuconazole and Trifloxystrobin. Gives protective, curative, and eradicative antifungal action with pronounced greening effect for clean grains and high test-weight.
products.dosage: 65 gm - 100 gm per acre in 100-120 Liters of water
products.applicationMethod: Foliar spray at boot leaf stage in rice and heading stage in wheat.
precautions: Store in dry original packaging
Keep out of reach of children and food items
